Name: Seamless Trees
Author: CatDragonbane
Description:
[b][size=3]UPDATED TO WORK WITH CONTENT PATCHER 2.0.0+ and Stardew Valley 1.6!
[/size][/b]
_________________________________________________________________________________

[b][size=3]About Seamless Trees:
[/size][/b]
It always bugged me that the trees in Stardew Valley don't match--especially the pine tree, which doesn't even have it's own summer version. With this mod, you will seamlessly be lost in the trees, regardless if you can chop them down or not!

This is a mod that I made for myself that I've decided to share. It was mostly created to match the pine trees, but I realized the other two trees were also slightly different, so they are included as well for all four seasons. Palm trees weren't touched as there are no palm trees outside of the boundaries I could find to match them to.
_________________________________________________________________________________

[size=3][b]Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
[i]THIS MOD IS INCOMPATIBLE [/i]with other mods that change the textures of "wood" trees. In order to use this mod with other mods that effect "wood" tree resource images, you will need to delete their image files. I won't be making this mod compatible with other mods unless I use a mod that requires it or there is enough people asking for compatibility. 

[i]THIS MOD IS INCOMPATIBLE[/i] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] and no patch will be made as the trees are already seamless. This mod is ONLY for those playing with the default vanilla tree textures!

_________________________________________________________________________________

[size=3]Install / Uninstall:[/size]

To install,
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI v4.0.1[/url]﻿ (or later if available).
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher v2.0.1[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿ or later.
[*]Download this mod, Seamless Trees!
[*]Run your game and immerse yourself in your new vanilla-friendly seamless landscape!
[/list][list]
[/list]To uninstall, delete the [CP] Seamless Trees folder from your Mods directory. Enjoy your vanilla not-seamless trees!
Please check the mod pages for required mods to properly uninstall those, if needed.
